title: Restore backpack strap footnote and Deck of Many Things asterisk legend
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P3 found two small prose gaps:
  1. Adventuring Gear table footnote: "You can also strap items, such as a bedroll or a coil of rope, to the outside of a backpack" is in no record.
  2. Deck of Many Things table keeps * markers on Vizier/Comet/The Fates but drops the legend "*Found only in a deck with twenty-two cards."
- The deck legend is mechanically relevant because it distinguishes 13-card vs 22-card deck contents; without it, tools cannot interpret the asterisk markers the table retains.

Acceptance criteria:
- Represent the backpack strap footnote in an appropriate equipment/backpack/adventuring-gear record or rule record.
- Represent the Deck of Many Things asterisk legend in table/item data so tools can interpret the marked rows.
- Add regression coverage for table footnotes/legends, especially where table cells retain markers.
close_reason: Restored backpack strap footnote and Deck of Many Things asterisk legend through importer-generated pack data with regression coverage.
